decisions.reason: The enclosed laser workstation builds directly on the firm's laser marking expertise and in-house R&D, so the firm can interpret results and refine the line, though its lower website visibility suggests a modest risk of consolidation into the newer cabins.
This thermal inkjet printer sits close to the firm's core inkjet coding knowledge, has kept a dedicated page in both years and fits its single-source portfolio.

The piezo inkjet printer extends the firm's established high-resolution printing competence, which the firm can assimilate and improve through its own development, and it remains presented on its own page.
This is a flagship laser line shown on the home page, building on core knowledge and aligned with the firm's Industry 4.0 direction.
The newly launched compact laser cabin builds on existing laser and workstation know-how, has a dedicated page and complements the flagship laser systems.
The lubricant printing system applies the firm's inkjet competence to sheet metal processing and won a trade fair award, giving related knowledge and early positive feedback to build on.
